title: Bound and resume MVCC pruning without a database-sized foreground pause
body:
<!-- mvcc-live-integration-status-20261014 -->

**Current priority (2026-10-15): actual native publication/Finish integration is active provisionally alongside ordinary vacuum/allocation repair.** [Current assignment and exact shared source snapshot](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/4878#issuecomment-6195392536). Sol6.1 `/root/allocation_zipper_5133_sol61` owns isolated `native-4878-actual-split-20261015`; `/root/mvcc_architecture_repair_sol61` owns ordinary #5111. Root owns Git/GitHub/merge. These current assignments supersede historical writer statements below; old native source leases remain protected. The accepted [publication/Finish split](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/4878#issuecomment-6192738262) remains binding; ordinary-only diagnostics V1–V3 are closed. Reuse SAME conditional mutation/current-basis validation, original transaction, fenced turn release and actual physical Finish. First prove a newer durable writer completes while original Finish is paused, its receipt remains live and Pruned ACK waits. No timing or broad native campaign before the first source/runtime checkpoint. Ordinary CI/merge, complete supported bounds, composite C1/C3 authority, performance and all final gates remain open; original Q32 RED/ACK0 is unchanged.

<!-- original33-production-route-20261015 -->
**Retained production result and architecture stop:** Original rows33/pointerfalse uses the backend route; output construction completes after92 legal intervening CommitAt writes, but ACK remains0 at final publication. Current composition has a source-backed lower bound of **58 records**, excluding other required work. Even generous direct-durable factoring gives at least37. [Exact census](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/4871#issuecomment-6190299834) and [frozen source/evidence `64cee841`](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/commit/64cee8410991f0712896e52162a594683ec35b18) retain the failed route and uncompiled drafts. Component controls do not establish whole-path viability.

**Work-accounting decision remains open:** The original issue required bounded work, foreground fencing, continuing-write progress and visible physical cleanup without specifying Q32/1MiB. Later contracts do specify those values and remain binding. Investigate explicit separate bounds for variable traversal and publication/control work, including all charged phases and their total; a lower bound is not an upper bound, and a counter alone proves neither latency nor progress. Adopt no replacement number or silent waiver. Before qualification under revised accounting, publish and reconcile the complete contract, actual operation/byte bounds, cache authority, durability, old-reader and physical Finish obligations. Original unchanged Q32 test and its RED result remain preserved even if a different contract is later explicitly selected.

The source preflight identifies eager retirement pruning, admission census, complete dependency projection and last-drop Finish as possible history-dependent costs. Reuse the original COW allocator, pointer deltas, persistent dependency trees and synchronous ACK barrier. A bounded diagnostic may precede a general bound, as explicitly scoped in the [new decision](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/4878#issuecomment-6191433730); it varies history at fixed selected-key geometry and reports every phase/full cost. This is a diagnostic-only revision of the earlier runtime ordering. Production qualification still requires a source-backed complete supported bound, continuing-write progress and cache-source authority, then short actual public viability/latency/outer-allocation evidence before exhaustive checks. Preserve all original/final graph obligations, existing M0 performance guards and required per-PR checks; do not invent a latency target without a qualified baseline. [Canonical state](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/4871#issuecomment-6157916554) records the current isolated ownership and preserves the earlier native STOP evidence. The [ordinary short comparison](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/4871#issuecomment-6190918226) is useful ordinary evidence, not native acceptance.

<!-- native-fresh-body-and-capsule-20261015 -->
**Astra-reviewed structural decision (2026-10-15): simplify promotion ownership before more continuation machinery.** [Accepted source findings, edit map, public gate and stop criteria](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/4871#issuecomment-6189177394). This supersedes preallocating a duplicate promotion root. `PreparePrimaryPromotionV6` currently runs after activation, clones/re-identifies/decodes/hashes/registers an immutable logical root to attach dependency custody, and has an unlimited-work synchronous Drop unwind. Capsule encoding consumes the original certificate. The existing slot/seal should instead own a genuine acquired reference to the original immutable root, its own dependency/manifest reference, and the capsule-image charge. Keep both durable capsule slots and their current/parent recovery images. Move the image charge off the logical root; migrate actual physical-closure enumeration, capture/recovery, both-slot overwrite and original retirement/Finish together. Simply aliasing `promotion.Root` while keeping dependency binding would grow an admitted reader closure. Reuse existing owners/arenas and SAME transaction/publisher/allocator/ledger/Finish; no generic ownership framework.

The canonical BODY must still be prepared before the fresh cut, then finalized into a NEW actual current generation/header/certificate with producer-verified retirement and current-directory graft. Preserve captured-base provenance and changed-class ancestry across ordinary PRIMARY puts so intervening replacements/new keys/absences survive. No rebinding of an old sealed proof. Keep private metadata images in memory until adoption, ledger tail claims distinct from pager growth, and physical-tail validation intact. The full256-record chunk encoder cannot run in the finalQ32 cut.

One complete public viability packet now replaces further component milestones: observe actual original33 retired/path/image/successor geometry once (do not assume R1/P1/M3/D1); meaningful RED then shared slot-custody/fresh-finalization plus affected ordinary consumers and original resumable Finish; immediately run unchanged SAME-Request rows33/pointerfalse Q32/1MiB/4096calls with legal CommitAt after every yield, physical Finish before ACK and existing old-reader/future/keeper/reopen assertions; then immediately measure public total cost, per-call pause and outer allocation bytes/objects. ACK remains0. This source-supported design is not a safety or Q32 proof. The current unchanged component composition is already>=30records before graft, metadata and activation, so wiring it unchanged is rejected.

If the complete fresh cut cannot honestly fitQ32, stop adding continuations and report the irreducible sequence/required representation decision. Continuing-write starvation is an architectural progress failure. A public cost failure triggers profiling of the complete operation. A generic ownership framework triggers reassessment of the smaller existing-slot seam. No quiet retries, held prepared slot across yield, scalar discounts, cap/fixture changes, or unlimited cleanup fallback. Focused lifetime/recovery checks precede diagnostics; stable-candidate qualification and every original final gate remain binding. Sole source owner remains Sol6.1 `/root/mvcc_architecture_repair_sol61`; Astra's explicit user exception was read-only strategic advice.

<!-- native-normal-retirement-20261015 -->

The constructor's exact-visible-clone fast path covers only its proven shared edge. New tokens preserving physical files cannot prove nested tree/rope/descriptor/imported-source edges nonlast.

Keep the same visible member's retirement and `Finish` custody. Reuse the original release graph with retained work progress at Set/kind cells, logical/physical indexes, rope entries, original token backings and imported-source descent. Preserve original release order, once-only consumption, first-error custody, alias detachment and accounting until actual release. No synchronous disposal fallback inside Publish, guardian retain, replay or inferred nonlast status. The production guard remains until the actual callback handles this normal path.

The next bounded regression must use production ValueLog + OuterLeafLog capture, overwrite both recovery slots across successive commits, and drive the same member through actual last-kind/imported-source retirement with bounded refusal/resumption and first-error checks. Then run the unchanged bounded production public sequence with one legal intervening write and immediately collect clean public latency/outer allocation. Focused checks precede this; expanded matrices and final Q32/close/reopen qualification remain at the stable-candidate gate. Shutdown registry teardown and truly unsupported foreign/DATA callbacks may refuse before effects only when outside that target eligibility.

Actual maintenance Snapshot/index-token and bank work producers are implemented. Corrected scoped-token last-idle pin and closing-table pre-effect refusal controls pass after a meaningful RED double-Complete accounting test was fixed (pointer holder clears before refund). These are component results, not production ACK credit. Sole source owner remains `/root/mvcc_architecture_repair_sol61`; finite shared-producer leases and protected foreign files remain enforced.

Other ordinary imports are read-only. Coherent imported source is the frozen120-file dirty closure plus genuine committed predecessor companions, not reconstructed ABI. The SAME retainedalloc.Owner terminal/removal/enrollment seam must charge actual binding walks/refunds without blocking legal producer growth across yields; no whole-list operation hidden in scalar work. Generic SAME-object cleanup must integrate back into #5111 before full qualification. Ordinary Close drives these same phases; hidden ordinary assistance cannot consume native-owned callbacks.

Reserve actual page-aligned unmapped extent plus descriptor traffic before each OS effect. SAME Pager constructors issue mapping authority and persist successful partial-unmap position through Unix MmapPtr/MunmapPtr; arbitrary slices never acquire pointer-unmap authority. Cover actual Growth rollback, original Close, larger-chunk domain, containing admission and sticky failure custody. Scalar512 whole-unmap pricing or shrinking the default chunk does not satisfy acceptance. Windows consumes a whole constructor view: preserve ordinary behavior/required CI and refuse unsupported native routes before ownership/floor/output effects under the existing [platform decision](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5111#issuecomment-6158492710); no full Windows feature-support obligation is added.

Connect privately prepared selected immutable deletion/projection to the fresh original current certificate/DATA base in one maintained final cut, including bounded directory copies/CRC/digest and SAME transaction/coordinator publication. Legal future writes continue between returns; actual physical Finish and cleanup outcome precede Pruned ACK. Original Q32/1MiB/input32/resource16/file17/two-index-file/SAME Request33/80/4096, all19, floor/anchor/old-reader/future-write/reopen, full Finish/Close, format/fault/shrink/cost/platform and Dgraph gates remain OPEN and unchanged. **Accepted shared architecture, 2026-10-14:** #4878 owns the complete maintained bounded public prune path. [Current seam decision and evidence](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/4871#issuecomment-6179448232); [canonical execution state](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/4871#issuecomment-6157916554). Shared ordinary consumers integrate in #5111; whole native qualification does not block qualification of an otherwise stable ordinary foundation.

At actual successful authority-fenced publication after `commitPublishedSeal`, consume the SAME original group and advance frontier/lineage once, releasing its publication turn so legal newer durable writes proceed. Retain the SAME native physical receipt, constructor/alias/callback custody, charges, reachability and activeDispatch join until actual Finish; native ACK waits for that receipt. Delayed completion never repeats the frontier update. Original pre-Stop Close must complete/join paused receipt outside conflicting locks, without another user prune call. Ordinary drives the SAME phases synchronously; no scheduler assistance, second authority, lifecycle registry or synchronous Batch.Write substitute. Preserve ambiguity/late-refusal first custody. Runtime Prepare/install/promotion and directory work must be genuinely finite connected stages, not scalar-wrapped synchronous callbacks.

All4 byte-identical protected fixture cases now capture SAME Request, select/prepare native rows and allow intervening durable writes, then explicitly refuse at publication-notconnected (ACK0/cut0). `capture-v3` raw SHA256 `c10c1ff0e64c5fa398d94f502530dc5523832290c28ae5cd37d1f3f3e60b3cdb`; fixture SHA256 `77f14c80a007ce9b918e007e5cce24e5d78ffa022c6a92386cfb58bda246d55f`. Construction progress is not acceptance. Default adaptive/NoWALFast fixture does not prove Dgraph COW-profile activation. Positive nonempty-overlay COW/CWAL activation is REQUIRED: extend the SAME installed composite cut/source provenance and canonical CWAL producer; removing the rejection or deleting backend rows alone is insufficient. Root explicitly released cow_cut.go/cow_batch.go to the native sole writer at the exact preimages in the linked decision; all other companion/GE leases remain unchanged. A small public RED precedes further backend-only expansion.

Unchanged focused gates include protected SAMERequest33/80/4096; paused native Finish followed by ordinary durable publication; Stop/Close while paused; ambiguous/late-refusal custody; representative actual target-profile activation/exclusion. Preserve Q32/1MiB/input32/resources16/files17/two-index caps, real selected DATA absence/current output, legal future writes, old readers/reopen and physical Finish-before-ACK. All19, format/fault/shrink/output/cost/platform/current-head CI/review/merge and final M0 gates remain OPEN. No stale-root retry ACK, scalar unlimited-work wrapper, changed fixture or cap waiver.
